name: Zeynep
self_text: I am a Brazilian in my 50s who spends my free time gazing at the stars with amateur astronomy. My path with photography began with my Leica, and these days, I am honestly just looking for a relaxed photo walk. A typical outing for me involves wandering through a quiet neighborhood or a park, simply enjoying the mood of the city. I am cool with taking portraits of each other during these strolls. Regarding the technical side, fair warning: gear talk is fine but not the point is my thing. Once we are back home, I am happy to teach post-processing for those interested in editing. In terms of scheduling, most weeks I can do Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a practice session working on specific shots and you have to be okay with gear talk being fine but not the point. It's a deal-breaker unless you are available Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings. Ideally, you are the one who learns post-processing from me, and it's a small bonus if you are okay with taking portraits of each other.
